notes: Consolidated IFRS financial statements in fullGBP units; EPS/payments originally published in pence are scaled toGBP. netIncome is total profit/loss attributable to ordinary shareholders, including discontinued operations; dilutedEPS also uses the continuing-and-discontinued line where separate lines are presented (FY2021/22 andFY2014). totalEquity excludes noncontrolling interests.

operatingIncome is the published operating profit/loss, not profit before financing/taxation, underlying profit or adjusted earnings. Revenue and operatingIncome follow the continuing-operation scope in the source report; netIncome remains total attributable income as required.

capex is the company-published PP&E purchases cash-flow line, negative. FY2017/18 are explicitly net of government grants in the company-published line; no gross-up is computed and separately published intangible additions are not added. OCF is after taxation.
Cash is the balance-sheet amount, not cash-flow-statement net cash including overdrafts; balances therefore differ from some cash-flow closing balances.

The2018report restatesFY2017 forIFRS15,ITP acquisition and other adjustments and gives the restated opening1January2017 balance sheet used forFY2016 assets/equity/cash. FY2016 income/cash flows remain the values actually published in the2016report because no FY2016IFRS15 income restatement was extracted; the scope break is retained.

FY2012 and the opening1January2012 balance sheet were restated in the2013report forIAS19 andRRSA accounting; those latest inspected values are used forFY2012 andFY2011 balance sheet respectively. FY2007/08 balance-sheet historical totals use the2010report five-year review; other fields use actual earlier statements or their comparatives.

FY2019 EPS and payment per share are adjusted for the bonus element of the2020rights issue as explicitly printed in the2020report. Earlier EPS/share-payment amounts remain published historical values, not an artificially share-adjusted whole-series calculation.

dividendPerShare includes company-reported payments to ordinary shareholders (historically viaC shares), with2025/2024 fiscal-year dividends including proposals as printed in2025note.2020 explicitly shows no payment. Missing dividends are null rather than inferred zero.

No aggregate totalDebt was independently extracted from the component debt/lease disclosures. Shares outstanding are not calculated from issued shares less treasury shares or substituted with an EPS weighted-average denominator. Employee counts were not independently extracted.
